scenarios.name: Boss: Pursuer (Wave 5)
scenarios.description: Wave 5 boss fight, no upgrades, wasteland biome.

scenarios.name: Boss: Core (Wave 10)
scenarios.description: Wave 10 boss fight, no upgrades, rupture biome.

scenarios.name: Boss: Reflector (Wave 15)
scenarios.description: Wave 15 boss fight, no upgrades, jungle biome. Reflector is permanently armored — trail encirclement never kills it. Survive and dodge.

scenarios.name: Boss: Core (Wave 10) — Loaded
scenarios.description: Wave 10 core boss, rupture biome, 4 offensive/defensive upgrades.

scenarios.name: Boss: Pursuer (Wave 5) — Fragile
scenarios.description: Wave 5 boss, 1 HP. For learning the boss pattern under pressure.

scenarios.name: Biome: Neon Wasteland (Wave 3)
scenarios.description: Wave 3, wasteland biome. Verify: white tint, orange fog (density 0.04), no enemy bias, wasteland music pack.

scenarios.name: Biome: Frozen Rupture (Wave 10)
scenarios.description: Wave 10, rupture biome. Verify: ice-blue tint 0xCCEEFF, blue fog (density 0.06), flanker bias ×1.8, rupture music pack.

scenarios.name: Biome: Corruption Jungle (Wave 15)
scenarios.description: Wave 15 jungle biome. Verify: green tint 0x88FF88, heavy green fog (density 0.12 — noticeably darker), jungle music pack.

scenarios.name: Splitter Stress (Wave 8)
scenarios.description: Wave 8 rupture biome with offensive upgrades. Tests splitter + chaser spawns.

scenarios.name: Splitter Unlock (Score 3500, Wave 6)
scenarios.description: Wave 6 with score pre-set to 3500 — the threshold where splitters enter the enemy pool. Verify: splitters appear in waves, split into 2 chasers on trail-encirclement kill. NOTE: bomb kill does NOT trigger split.

scenarios.name: Pickup: Time Slow
scenarios.description: Wave 3, forces the next pickup drop to be a time_slow. Verify: blue clock icon spawns, collecting it slows time for 3 seconds.

scenarios.name: Pickup: Trail Token
scenarios.description: Wave 3, forces the next pickup drop to be a trail_token. Verify: magenta diamond icon spawns, collecting it adds +200 max trail points.

scenarios.name: Pickup: Shield
scenarios.description: Wave 4, forces the next pickup drop to be a shield_pickup. Verify: green pentagon icon spawns, collecting it grants one-time shield (absorbs next hit).

scenarios.name: Shop: Flush (300 Scrap, Wave 3)
scenarios.description: Wave 3 with 300 scrap pre-seeded. When the wave ends, all shop items should be purchasable: Field Repair (8), Brief Invincibility (5), Score Surge (12). Verify affordability highlight and purchase deduction.

scenarios.name: Shop: Broke (0 Scrap, Wave 3)
scenarios.description: Wave 3 with 0 scrap. All shop buttons should appear disabled (grayed out). Verify no purchase is possible.

scenarios.name: Upgrade Bias: Rupture (Wave 10)
scenarios.description: Wave 10 in Rupture biome with 300 scrap. At upgrade break, verify: tight_turns and drift_king appear with higher frequency than normal (×2 bias), drift_shield at ×1.5. Use reroll to confirm bias holds across offers.

scenarios.name: Upgrade Bias: Jungle (Wave 15)
scenarios.description: Wave 15 in Jungle biome with 300 scrap. At upgrade break, verify: max_hp and hp_regen appear more often (×2 bias), damage_resist at ×1.5.

scenarios.name: Boss Reward: Simulated Kill (Wave 6)
scenarios.description: Wave 6 non-boss wave with bossDefeated flag. When wave ends, the upgrade break should show +1 reroll, gold flash, shake, and BOSS DEFEATED! banner — without needing to fight a boss.

scenarios.name: Combo: Cyan Ring (Combo 4)
scenarios.description: Wave 5 with combo pre-set to 4. Verify: encirclement ring is cyan (4–6× range). Also useful as a screenshot preset.

scenarios.name: Combo: Magenta Ring (Combo 7)
scenarios.description: Wave 8 with combo pre-set to 7. Verify: encirclement ring is magenta (≥7× range). Encircling 3+ enemies should spawn a scaled shard burst. Also useful for MAX_COMBO=16 verification.
